[[File:Scott Lingrell 2015 Hall of Fame.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Scott Lingrell, inducted into the Players Committee Hall of Fame in 2015.]]
'''Scott Lingrell''' ([[GEMP]] handle '''advocate'''; also '''crngwell''')<ref name="yt">[https://www.youtube.com/@crngwell @crngwell] on YouTube. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20260927195243/https://www.youtube.com/@crngwell Wayback 27 September 2026]</ref> is the current [[Lead Advocate]] of the [[Players Committee]]. He was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] (Rogue 60).<ref name="slack-lingrell-2026">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Scott Lingrell, 9 October 2026. "Also, it's not complete. I was gold 60 I think. Rogue 60 sorry"</ref> He volunteered for the Players Committee in 2002, including running a Classic Format playtest at DecipherCon 2002.<ref name="dcon2002">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021106101746/http://www.swccgpc.com/ The SWCCG Player's Committee], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 6 November 2002; news dated 29 October 2002)</ref> ''The Ringer'' reported that he joined the committee in 2004.<ref name="ringer">[https://www.theringer.com/2018/05/21/star-wars/star-wars-customizable-card-game-player-community The Force Is Strong With This 'Star Wars' Subculture], Ben Lindbergh, ''The Ringer'' (21 May 2018). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20250524105937/https://www.theringer.com/2018/05/21/star-wars/star-wars-customizable-card-game-player-community Wayback 24 May 2025]</ref> The first dated Advocate Council snapshot that names him is 29 August 2005, as Card Design Advocate.<ref name="council2005">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050829220138/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 29 August 2005)</ref> He later served as [[Design Advocate]] and then as Lead Advocate.<ref name="hof">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200628022310/https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Wayback 28 June 2020]</ref> He was in the final eight of the 2001 World Championship ([[FreedomCon]]).<ref name="fc-forum">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=75427 SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History], forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020; players' recollection of the 2001 top 8). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html Internet Archive]</ref> The community gave him a Lifetime Achievement Award in 2011, and the Players Committee enshrined him in the Hall of Fame on 8 August 2015.<ref name="hof" />
